enemy_intro_entry.description: One designer-authored enemy/boss introduction dialogue: which round it pops up on, what it says, and which existing enemy sprite slot it shows enlarged. Two entries may share the same round (they queue and show one after another).

body.description: The flavor/stat text shown below the title, word-wrapped in the panel. Free text, not auto-generated from live enemy stats.

enemy_label.description: Designer-facing label for this entry (e.g. 'Raider' or 'Boss (Era 2)') — for your own bookkeeping in the editor only, never cross-checked against enemies.json's EnemyTypes keys.

round.description: The round number this dialogue pops up on, at the very start of the attacking (ENEMY) phase. Independent of the enemy's own start_round in enemies.json — set it to whatever round you want the story beat to land on.

sprite_h.description: Height in pixels of the sprite box drawn inside the panel.

sprite_slot.description: Which existing enemy sprite slot (data/slots.json, 'enemies' category) to draw enlarged in this panel. Adding a brand new enemy sprite slot later needs a matching addition to this enum.

sprite_w.description: Width in pixels of the sprite box drawn inside the panel.

title.description: The header line shown at the top of the panel body, above the sprite.

description: Core balancing domain (D-10), REPLAN nested tree (Phase 9A): camera, general, phase loop, XP, the hole, lightning strike, debug-mode telemetry. Values are the prototype's live tuning, verbatim. Bounds policy: fractions 0-1, costs/counts 0-10000, rounds/levels 0-1000, seconds 0-60, camera zoom factors 0.1-100.

BossBonuses.description: The six stacking boss A/B story bonuses (boss1a..boss3b). Each stack multiplies its own magnitude; the counted quantity is read off the live board/state.

dmg_per_building.description: Boss1B: extra per-shot damage every defender gains, per stack, for each ALIVE non-base building on the board (x10 combat scale, D-12).

dmg_per_lightning_building.description: Boss3B: extra per-shot damage every defender gains, per stack, for each ALIVE lightning-source building built (x10 combat scale, D-12).

dmg_per_love_chunk.description: Boss3A: extra per-shot damage every defender gains, per stack, for each whole love_chunk_size of love held at End Turn (x10 combat scale, D-12).

dmg_per_unbuilt_tile.description: Boss1A: extra per-shot damage every defender gains, per stack, for each unbuilt (BUILDABLE) tile (x10 combat scale, D-12).

level_past_threshold.description: Boss2A: the in-tier level a building must exceed to pay love (a building at level_past_threshold+2 pays twice).

love_chunk_size.description: Boss3A: the love-held chunk size the damage bonus is counted per. A divisor - never 0.

love_per_level_past.description: Boss2A: love per round, per stack, for each in-tier building level past level_past_threshold.

love_per_low_level_building.description: Boss2B: love per round, per stack, for each ALIVE non-base building sitting at in-tier level low_level_target.

low_level_target.description: Boss2B: the exact in-tier level a building must sit at to pay love.

Camera.description: Camera zoom (E-5). Overrides geometry.json's zoom_levels/default fallback at load time (engine/coords/__init__.py::load_coordinate_system) so zoom is a designer-editable balancing tunable, not baked into geometry.json.

default_zoom.description: Zoom factor the camera opens at. Must be a member of zoom_levels (cross-field check enforced at load time via CoordinateSystem.set_zoom, not expressible in schema).

zoom_levels.description: The discrete camera zoom factors the wheel steps through, ascending.

Debug.description: Debug-mode run telemetry (game/debug) and the main-menu entry points that arm it. These gate which run modes the menu offers and what a debug run captures by default; they never change gameplay balance.

ask_player_identity.description: Ask for a player name + experience level before a debug run starts; stamps them into the log filenames and reports.

debug_mode_available.description: Show the PLAY DEBUG row and its SET gear on the main menu.

default_level.description: Initial debug recorder detail level (1 = causal trace, 2 = + per-tick combat detail).

default_output_csv.description: Write the per-round .csv table by default.

default_output_jsonl.description: Write the .jsonl event stream by default.

regular_mode_available.description: Show START NEW GAME on the main menu as a regular (uninstrumented) run.

EnemyIntro.description: Designer-authored enemy/boss introduction dialogue windows (feature-enemy-intro-dialogue). Pops up on the right side of the screen at the start of the attacking phase of a chosen round, freezing the world like Levelup/Boss-cutscene, showing an enlarged enemy sprite plus free text. Ships with an empty entries list — nothing shows until entries are authored.

entries.description: Every authored intro dialogue. Two entries sharing the same round both fire, one after another (queued).

window.description: Global defaults shared by every entry — the window's own size and timing (per-entry only the sprite size is tunable, see enemy_intro_entry).

close_seconds.description: Duration of the slide+fade-out animation, whether triggered by the hold timer expiring or by a manual close (X / Esc / right-click).

height.description: Window height in pixels, vertically centered on screen.

hold_seconds.description: How long the window stays fully open before auto-closing, once the open animation finishes.

open_seconds.description: Duration of the slide+fade-in animation from the right edge of the screen.

width.description: Window width in pixels, docked to the right edge of the screen when fully open.

game_scale_rounds.description: Rounds per difficulty era (drives era pacing).

starting_currency.description: Love the player starts the game with.

LightningStrike.description: The click-to-strike active ability. Per-level arrays are index-aligned: level N uses damage[N-1], radius[N-1], cooldown[N-1].

items.description: Rounds between strikes at this level.

damage.description: Damage per level (x10 combat scale, D-12).

radius.description: Strike radius in tiles per level.

income_phase_duration.description: Seconds the income phase banner/floaters play before build phase.

round_end_delay.description: Seconds of pause after the last enemy dies before the income phase.

speed_1_5x_min_round.description: First round the 1.5x combat speed button unlocks.

speed_2x_min_round.description: First round the 2x combat speed button unlocks.

base_hp.description: The hole's hit points, in absolute HP - deliberately NOT x10 combat scale (BASE_HP stays 10; prototype exception, D-12).

base_income.description: Love the hole itself produces per income phase.

base_kills_enemies.description: If true, enemies that reach the hole die in it (dealing their damage).

base_lives.description: Lives before game over — an enemy reaching the hole costs one life and wipes the round.

building_revive.description: If true, buildings destroyed during the round revive at the income phase (canonical flag; was BUILDING_REVIVE + FEATURE_BUILDING_REVIVE).

economy_buildings_required.description: Number of economy buildings the player must place before the tutorial's first End Turn is allowed / the first-end-turn cutscene fires.

base_income_per_village_level.description: Love added to the base income for every village level above 1.

levelup_love_reward.description: Love granted on each village levelup.

village_xp_base_threshold.description: XP needed for the first village level.

village_xp_threshold_inc.description: Extra XP needed per subsequent level.

village_xp_threshold_inc_growth.description: Growth added to the increment each level (accelerating curve).

xp_from_buildings.description: If true, buildings dying grants XP per BuildingsGlobal xp_on_death (canonical flag; was FEATURE_XP_FROM_BUILDINGS).

xp_on_base_damage_kill.description: If true, enemies that die by hitting the base still grant XP.
